declarations.docstring: Constructs a sequence supported at one index whose image is the tensor of a single vertex coefficient with a module element.
Constructs a sequence supported at a chosen index whose image is the next coordinate of the given element.
The linear map from a tensor product to finitely supported tensor-valued sequences.
The tensor-to-finitely-supported-sequence map is injective.
Evaluating the image of a pure tensor at an index applies the corresponding component map to its first factor.
The successor coordinate of the boundary image is the difference of adjacent coordinate images.
The zeroth coordinate of the boundary image is the negation of the zeroth action image.
Computes a successor boundary coordinate on a nested pure tensor as a difference of two pure tensors.
Computes the zeroth boundary coordinate on a nested pure tensor as a negated pure tensor.
A successor component of a product with an embedded finitely supported element equals the preceding component times that element.
The zeroth component of a product with an embedded finitely supported element vanishes.
Computes a component of the product of two specified generators, with support at the successor of the first generator's index.
The boundary morphism is pointwise the difference of the multiplication and action morphisms.
The quiver morphism from the tensor construction to its target induced by multiplication of tensor factors.
The multiplication morphism sends a nested pure tensor to the pure tensor obtained by multiplying its first two factors.
The quiver morphism from the tensor construction to its target induced by the scalar action on the module factor.
The action morphism sends a nested pure tensor to the pure tensor obtained by acting on its module factor.
A quiver morphism into the restricted-scalar target using multiplication in the first tensor factor.
The additive map into the restricted-scalar target associated with multiplication in the first tensor factor.
The restricted additive multiplication map sends a pure tensor to the tensor with its first factor embedded.
The curried additive map sending two inputs to their pure tensor after embedding the first.
The curried multiplication map evaluates to the pure tensor with embedded first input.
Scaling the first input of the curried multiplication map agrees with scaling its second input.
The restricted multiplication morphism sends a pure tensor to the tensor with embedded first factor.
A quiver morphism into the restricted-scalar target using the first input's action on the module factor.
The additive map into the restricted-scalar target associated with action on the module factor.
The restricted additive action map sends a pure tensor to one tensored with the acted-on module element.
The curried additive map sending two inputs to one tensored with the action on the second input.
The curried action map evaluates to one tensored with the acted-on second input.
Scaling the first input of the curried action map agrees with scaling its second input.
The restricted action morphism sends a pure tensor to one tensored with the acted-on module factor.
